nodes.label: UI/UX Design System dan Spesifikasi Layar
Concept: Two-Layer i18n (static .po catalog + per-locale DB content)
nodes.rationale: Static UI chrome strings live in bundled gettext .po/.pot catalogs (en/id) rendered via t(key), while user-authored content needing multiple languages is stored per-locale in the database — separating developer-owned text from user-owned content.

nodes.label: Concept: Reduced-Motion-Safe Motion System
nodes.rationale: Token-driven durations/easings plus a global prefers-reduced-motion neutralizer (collapsing all transitions to 0.01ms) ensure WCAG 2.3.3 compliance; surfaces not importing tokens.css must carry their own copy of the guard.
